reference: PLAN: 1. Find information about films produced by Lawrence Turman. 2. Identify which of those films featured a character named "Johnny 5" and note the release year of its sequel.

descendants_plus.hop_1: FINDING: Lawrence Turman produced a film titled "Short Circuit" (1986), which starred Fisher Stevens as Johnny 5, a friendly, naive, self-aware robot. The sequel to this film was released in 1988.
